summary: Ketu in the lagna is classically adverse for body, standing and reputation, giving a lean or weak constitution and an unsettled, inward or unusual personality; modern authors add intuition, psychic sensitivity and a spiritual bent.
common_outcomes: Weak, lean or emaciated constitution (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Foss name 83 'disease')
Unhappiness or loss of position (Phaladeepika 8.28)
Instability, restlessness, wandering disposition (Raman HJH; Braha)
Intuition, psychic or spiritual leanings (Raman HJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika 8.28: ungrateful, a tale-bearer, an outcast, associates with the wicked, bodily deformity
Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): troublesome to family members, wind complaints
Bhrigu Sutras 1-4 (Rahu or Ketu): in Aries, Taurus or Cancer, kind-hearted and fond of enjoyments; with a malefic aspect, facial marks
Braha: makes the person go unnoticed or seem invisible to others

by_area.personality: Morbid imagination, strange appetites, excitability, possible deceitfulness (Raman HJH); shy, changeable, many-faceted, intuitive and discriminating (Braha); diplomatic (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.health: Weak constitution and emaciated figure (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology); wind troubles (Chamatkar Chintamani); danger from poisons or contaminated food (Braha); disease (Foss name 83, especially in childhood).
by_area.relationships: Married life unhappy unless other configurations help (Raman HJH); ups and downs, spouse may be domineering (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Psychic powers likely (Raman HJH); interest in enlightenment and the occult (Braha).

strengtheners: Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: psychic, spiritual, profound discrimination, respected (Braha)
Ketu in a kendra connected with a kendra/trikona lord becomes a yogakaraka (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu or Rahu in the lagna while the lagna lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th: bodily trouble in the lagna lord's dasa (Jataka Parijata 11.31)
Ketu in Cancer or Leo heightens the negatives (Braha)
Ketu in the lagna with the 8th lord is quoted from Bhavartha Ratnakara as shortening life (Bhrigu Sutras commentary, 8th-house Saturn section)
lagna_or_context_notes: Rahu is always in the 7th. Phaladeepika 8.34: Ketu gives results like Mars. Braha says Ketu gives its full effects around the 48th year. Node dignity is disputed: Braha treats Gemini and Virgo as the only agreed strong signs for either node (and Cancer/Leo as weak); Chamatkar Chintamani, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary, singles out Aries, Virgo and Scorpio (and Gemini, Virgo for the 2nd) as good signs for Ketu.

source_views.view: Ungrateful, unhappy, a tale-bearer, an outcast, fallen from position, with a deformed body, associating with the wicked.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 9 (Rahu and Ketu), sutras 1-4 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)

source_views.view: Ketu or Rahu in the lagna with the lagna lord in a dusthana: privation of a limb in the relevant dasa.

source_views.view: Psychic powers likely; weak constitution, emaciated; instability and deceitfulness; morbid imagination, strange appetites, excitability, wandering; married life unhappy unless helped.

source_views.view: Emaciated, weak constitution, heavy perspiration, weak-hearted, slender, piles, diplomatic.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Ketu in the 1st house' section
source_views.view: Bad for married life; intuitive, spiritual or ascetic; discriminative; occult interest; weak constitution; danger from poisons; goes unnoticed; changeable; lack of confidence. Gemini/Virgo: psychic, spiritual, respected.

source_views.view: 'In the first house he causes disease' (83); Foss notes Ketu rules endings and may bring health issues, especially in childhood.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. Phaladeepika is entirely negative; Raman and Braha add psychic or spiritual capacity. The Bhrigu Sutras give the same sign-based relief (Aries, Taurus, Cancer) as for Rahu, while Braha treats Cancer as weak for the nodes.
phrasing_guidance: Describe an inward, perceptive and somewhat elusive personality; encourage grounding routines and self-care. Avoid words like 'outcast' or predictions of illness; mention partnership balance (Rahu in 7th) gently.

summary: Ketu in the 2nd is classically poor for speech, learning, family harmony and finances, with mouth or eye complaints; a minority view (Foss's name-list, Ketu in Gemini/Virgo or Aries) gives distinctive speech and comforts.
common_outcomes: Harsh, vile or poor speech (Phaladeepika 8.28; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Lack of wealth or learning; financial liabilities (Phaladeepika 8.28; Bhrigu Sutras 5-6; Raman HJH; Braha)
Mouth or eye complaints (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Braha)
Family troubles (Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Depends on others for food (Phaladeepika 8.28)
Success in spiritualism, navigation, mystical arts or hospital work (Raman HJH)
Friction with government (Chamatkar Chintamani)
Foss names 67 and 82: distinct, penetrating speech and 'many forms of happiness'

by_area.career: Spiritualism, navigation, mystical arts, hospitals (Raman HJH).
by_area.finance: Devoid of wealth (Phaladeepika 8.28); loss through fraud and deception (Raman HJH); loss of wealth (Chamatkar Chintamani); poverty (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6).
by_area.health: Diseases of the mouth (Chamatkar Chintamani); speech problems, poor food or intoxicants (Braha); disease and loss of children (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6).
by_area.family: Troubles from family members (Chamatkar Chintamani); family life marred (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Braha (Gemini/Virgo): especially well versed in spiritual subjects.

Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: good education, wealth, fine speaker (Braha)
Node in the 2nd associated with or aspected by the 5th or 9th lord: wealth and longevity (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)

A malefic joined with the 2nd/7th lord while a node is in the 2nd/7th: dangerous dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)
lagna_or_context_notes: Rahu is in the 8th. Braha: whenever the nodes are in the 2nd or 8th, happiness is disturbed. Node dignity is disputed: Braha treats Gemini and Virgo as the only agreed strong signs for either node (and Cancer/Leo as weak); Chamatkar Chintamani, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary, singles out Aries, Virgo and Scorpio (and Gemini, Virgo for the 2nd) as good signs for Ketu.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.28 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)

source_views.view: Mouth diseases, bitterness with the government, loss of wealth, family troubles; in Aries, Gemini or Virgo, all comforts.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa) Kanda I, section 6, slokas 14-15 (tr. S.S. Sareen)
source_views.view: A node in the 2nd or 7th with or aspected by the 5th or 9th lord gives wealth and longevity; a malefic with the 2nd/7th lord makes the dasa dangerous.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the second house ('Planets in the Second House')
source_views.view: Bad speaker; loss through fraud and deception; financial liabilities; success in spiritualism, navigation, mystical arts, hospitals.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Bad speaker, quiet, quick in perception, peevish, harsh, thrifty and economical.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Ketu in the 2nd house' section
source_views.view: Poor and unhappy, possibly foul or untruthful speech, speech problems, bad food or intoxicants, education and family life marred. Gemini/Virgo: good education, spiritual knowledge, wealth, excellent speaker.

source_views.source: Andrew Foss, The Yoga of the Planets: Ketu, the South Node (commentary on the 108-name list of the graha), names 67, 82
source_views.view: In the 2nd Ketu gives distinct speech (67) and many forms of happiness (82); Foss reports Indian jyotishis objected to the latter but he has seen it confirmed.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)

summary: Ketu in the 3rd is its most favourable house in several sources: long life, courage, strength, wealth and fame, at the cost of a sibling or of harmony with siblings.
common_outcomes: Long life, strength, wealth and fame (Phaladeepika 8.29; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Courageous, adventurous (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Loss of, or little happiness from, a sibling (Phaladeepika 8.29; Braha)
Victory over enemies and great prosperity (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
rare_outcomes: Happy married life and good food (Phaladeepika 8.29)
Hallucinations or mental disturbance (Raman HJH)
Foss name 62: enmity in the 3rd house
Artistic talent and popularity (Hindu Predictive Astrology)

by_area.personality: Strong and adventurous but fearful underneath ('funky') (Raman HJH); interesting, respected, brave (Braha).
by_area.career: Gemini/Virgo: excellence in writing or communication, organisational talent (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.29; Hindu Predictive Astrology); abundance of oilseeds (Bhrigu Sutras 7-8).
by_area.relationships: Happy with spouse (Phaladeepika 8.29); controversies and no friends (Chamatkar Chintamani).
by_area.family: Loss of a brother (Phaladeepika 8.29); little or no happiness from siblings (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Good placement for a seeker: fewer cravings and non-attachment to one's efforts (Braha).

strengtheners: Uttara Kalamrita 4.9: Ketu is most benefic in the 3rd
Malefics in upachaya houses (Uttara Kalamrita 4.16)
Ketu in Gemini or Virgo (Braha)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Frawley lists the 3rd among Ketu's 'difficult houses' calling for remedies
Association with a benefic gives a mark on the neck (Bhrigu Sutras 7-8)

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa) Kanda I, section 4, sloka 9 (tr. S.S. Sareen)

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the third house ('Planets in the Third House')

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Ketu in the 3rd house' section

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)

Uttara Kalamrita and Phaladeepika rate the 3rd highly, while Frawley lists it among Ketu's difficult houses and Foss's name-list gives enmity. Raman HJH is mixed (strong but fearful).

summary: Ketu in the 4th disturbs home, property, the mother and contentment, often bringing relocation far from one's birthplace; a counter-view (Foss's name 61) sees inner bliss or spiritual contentment.
common_outcomes: Loss or instability of land, vehicles, home and happiness (Phaladeepika 8.29; Raman HJH; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Braha)
Strained relationship with, or worries about, the mother (Phaladeepika 8.29; Raman HJH; Braha; Foss name 72)
Living abroad or away from the native place (Phaladeepika 8.29; Raman HJH; Braha)
Reversals and sudden changes (Raman HJH)
rare_outcomes: Living at the bounty of others (Phaladeepika 8.29)
Exceptional experiences at the end of life (Raman HJH)
Fear of poisons; quarrelsome (Hindu Predictive Astrology)

by_area.relationships: Devoid of happiness from friends (Chamatkar Chintamani).
by_area.family: Deprived of mother or her happiness (Phaladeepika 8.29; Raman HJH); mother may be weak or sickly (Braha); mother distressed with a malefic, not with a benefic (Bhrigu Sutras 9-10).
by_area.spirituality: Strong interest in enlightenment from a moksha-house kendra (Braha); bliss of the 'fourth state' (Foss name 61).

Kendra placement connected with a kendra/trikona lord (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52)

source_views.view: Quarrelsome, weak, fear of poisons; also lists licentiousness.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Ketu in the 4th house' section

summary: Ketu in the 5th is classically adverse for children and digestion and can unsettle the mind, while modern authors note intuition, discrimination and a turn to spiritual practice.
common_outcomes: Loss of children, few children, or sorrow through them (Phaladeepika 8.30; Bhrigu Sutras 11-13; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Foss name 58)
Stomach trouble (Phaladeepika 8.30; Chamatkar Chintamani; Raman HJH)
Strange emotional experiences; later inclination to spirituality (Raman HJH; Braha)
Disturbed love affairs and failed speculation (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Trouble from spirits/goblins (Phaladeepika 8.30)
Childlessness attributed to a Brahmin's curse (Phaladeepika 12)
Foss name 66: performance of spiritual austerities
Courageous but dependent on others (Chamatkar Chintamani)

by_area.family: Loss of or few children (Phaladeepika 8.30; Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Later in life an inclination to spirituality (Raman HJH); spiritual practices or natural healing (Braha); spiritual austerities (Foss name 66).

Trikona placement connected with a kendra/trikona lord (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52)

source_views.view: In the 5th Ketu brings grief (58) — Foss says this need not deny children — and indicates spiritual austerities (66).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)

summary: Ketu in the 6th is widely held to be its best or one of its best placements: victory over enemies, fame and authority, fulfilled wishes and good qualities, though some sources note odd illnesses or loose morals.
common_outcomes: Destroys enemies; foeless (Phaladeepika 8.30; Raman HJH; Braha)
Lasting fame and high authority (Phaladeepika 8.30; Raman HJH)
Magnanimous, with fine qualities; wishes realised (Phaladeepika 8.30)
Intuitive or occult powers (Raman HJH)
rare_outcomes: Strange, hard-to-diagnose illnesses or weight problems (Braha)
Loss of reputation through a maternal uncle; owns cattle (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Loose moral character (Raman HJH); good conversationalist, learned (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Bhrigu Sutras 14-16 (Rahu or Ketu): tolerant and very happy

summary: Ketu in the 7th unsettles marriage and partnerships: loss of respect, separation or a sickly, difficult or unusual spouse in the classics; modern authors allow a spiritual, detached or ascetic partner and a 'higher path' reading.
common_outcomes: Disturbed married life, separation or loss of the spouse (Phaladeepika 8.31; Bhrigu Sutras 17-21; Raman HJH; Braha)
Sickly or weak spouse (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Raman HJH; Braha)
Humiliation or disrespect (Phaladeepika 8.31; Raman HJH)
Bowel or intestinal disorders; loss of vitality (Phaladeepika 8.31; Raman HJH)
rare_outcomes: Chamatkar Chintamani: danger from watery places; in Scorpio, always happy
Spouse who is spiritual, psychic or ascetic (Braha)

by_area.relationships: Separated from the spouse, drawn to bad company (Phaladeepika 8.31); unhappy marriage, sickly spouse (Raman HJH); spouse may be weak, strange or deceitful, or spiritual and discriminating (Braha); two marriages unless a benefic joins (Bhrigu Sutras 17-21).
by_area.spirituality: Higher path through the 7th (Foss name 80); spiritual or ascetic partner (Braha).

Association with a benefic: one marriage, no glandular disease (Bhrigu Sutras 17-21)
Node in the 7th with or aspected by the 5th or 9th lord: wealth and longevity (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)
Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: intelligent, special or spiritual spouse (Braha)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Association with a malefic: glandular disease (Bhrigu Sutras 17-21)
Saturn with Ketu in the 7th intensifies the relationship warnings (Bhrigu Sutras 32-36)
A malefic joined with the 2nd/7th lord while a node is in the 2nd/7th (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)
lagna_or_context_notes: Rahu is in the 1st. BPHS 18.7-8 groups Saturn, Rahu and Ketu in the 7th as indicating low-status sexual associations.

source_views.view: Passionate, danger to the spouse; also lists irregular relationships.

source_views.view: Married life harmed; partner weak, sickly, strange or deceitful, or spiritual, psychic, ascetic. Gemini/Virgo: an especially intelligent, spiritual, detached spouse.

summary: Ketu in the 8th is classically one of its hardest placements: obstacles, separations, quarrels, injuries and chronic complaints; benefic aspect or a good sign (Scorpio, Virgo, Aries per Chamatkar Chintamani; Gemini/Virgo per Braha) brings wealth, intuition and long life.
common_outcomes: Obstacles or failure in undertakings (Phaladeepika 8.31)
Chronic or strange illnesses, excretory or reproductive trouble (Raman HJH; Braha; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Foss name 81)
Separation from dear ones, quarrels (Phaladeepika 8.31; Braha)
Shortage of funds; no benefit from the partner's wealth (Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Injury from weapons or a fall (Phaladeepika 8.31; Chamatkar Chintamani)
Ketu in the 8th aspected by a benefic: much wealth and long life (Raman HJH)
Accumulation of wealth if Ketu is in Scorpio, Virgo or Aries (Chamatkar Chintamani)
Good intuition but a materialistic bent (Braha)

by_area.personality: Dull, obscure (Hindu Predictive Astrology); covets others' wealth when afflicted (Raman HJH).
by_area.finance: Short of funds (Chamatkar Chintamani); no gain from partner's wealth (Braha); much wealth with benefic aspect (Raman HJH).
by_area.health: Piles (Chamatkar Chintamani); excretory disorders (Raman HJH); strange chronic illness, reproductive problems (Braha); stomach disorders from either node in the 6th/8th (Santhanam's note to BPHS 17.3-5).
by_area.relationships: Separation from dear friends, quarrels (Phaladeepika 8.31); domestic happiness harmed, family separations (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Braha: Ketu's moksha and knowledge significations are spoiled here (except in Gemini/Virgo, which give intuition and occult interest).

Strong 8th lord or benefic association improves longevity indications (Bhrigu Sutras 22-23)

Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th associated with the lords of those houses: harm in its dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 17-18)
Frawley lists the 8th among Ketu's difficult houses

summary: Ketu in the 9th is classically adverse for fortune, righteousness and the father; modern readings add short temper and haughtiness but also valour, thrift and a good spouse, with fortune restored when Ketu is well placed.
common_outcomes: Misfortune or ill luck (Phaladeepika 8.32; Braha)
Strain with or loss of the father (Phaladeepika 8.32; Braha); poor treatment of parents (Raman HJH)
Unrighteous conduct or slandering the good in classical lists (Phaladeepika 8.32; Bhrigu Sutras 24; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Foss name 57)
Little interest in philosophy or religion (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Wealth earned with the help of foreigners; anxious for children (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Good spouse and children; many children (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Eloquent, valorous, fond of pomp; saves money through frugality (Raman HJH)

by_area.relationships: Good wife (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.family: Deprived of the father (Phaladeepika 8.32); hostile to parents (Raman HJH); difficulties with a father whose life may be troubled (Braha); good children (Raman HJH).
by_area.spirituality: Foss: Ketu here may indicate religious extremism or experiencing 'papa' (demerit), though he softens the term.

summary: Ketu in the 10th mixes obstacles and irregular conduct in career with boldness, renown and, in several sources, pilgrimage and spiritual inclination; as an upachaya malefic it can give marked career success.
common_outcomes: Energetic, bold, widely renowned (Phaladeepika 8.32; Raman HJH)
Obstacles in undertakings or in good works (Phaladeepika 8.32; Raman HJH)
Pilgrimages, religious study, spiritual disciplines (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Rath)
Career success as a malefic in an upachaya house (Braha; Foss name 78)

Bhrigu Sutras 25-28 (Rahu or Ketu): relations with widows, poor quarters; better places with a benefic; interest in poetry
Work in an unusual profession or one 'related to the upward direction', e.g. aviation (Foss name 78)
Fertile brain, happy (Hindu Predictive Astrology)

by_area.family: No happiness from father (Chamatkar Chintamani); Rath: the nodes in the 10th obstruct the 9th (father, fortune) by argala.
by_area.spirituality: Religious, scripturally learned, many pilgrimages when beneficially disposed (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology); Rath: Ketu's beneficial argala on the 12th leads to the spiritual path and meditation.

Beneficially disposed Ketu (Raman HJH); association with a benefic (Bhrigu Sutras 25-28)

Papargala on the 9th: hardship for the father or guru (Rath)

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 11th (Ketu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: All kinds of gains; fortunate, learned, well dressed; children unfortunate.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the eleventh house ('Planets in the Eleventh House')
source_views.view: Habit of hoarding; windfalls through speculation; noble with many good qualities; succeeds in all ventures; charitable works.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Humorous, witty, intelligent, wealthy; also lists licentiousness.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Ketu in the 11th house' section
source_views.view: Successful undertakings and fortunate gains; strange friends or difficulties with them; scriptures say learned and wealthy with many fine qualities.

source_views.source: Andrew Foss, The Yoga of the Planets: Ketu, the South Node (commentary on the 108-name list of the graha), names 79
source_views.view: 'In the eleventh house he gives fame' (79).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. The only real divergence is about children: Chamatkar Chintamani says unfortunate, the Bhrigu Sutras say blessed with children.
phrasing_guidance: Describe steady gains and quiet success, with a detached attitude to reward; mention friendships that may be unusual. Avoid promising windfalls.

summary: Ketu in the 12th is read in two ways: classical verses stress secret wrongdoing, wasteful spending and eye trouble, while many later and modern authors regard it as an excellent placement for spiritual liberation, charity and foreign residence.
common_outcomes: Expenditure, sometimes wasteful (Phaladeepika 8.33; Braha) or on charities (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Eye troubles (Phaladeepika 8.33; Bhrigu Sutras 31-32; Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha)
Spiritual insight and interest in liberation (Frawley; Braha)
Restless mind, foreign residence, travel (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
rare_outcomes: Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): like a king, spends on charities, enemies vanquished
Ability to ward off negative psychic influences (Frawley)
Foss name 74: heroism or enmity
Inherited property may be lost (Raman HJH)

by_area.personality: Capricious, unsettled (Hindu Predictive Astrology); restless, wandering mind (Raman HJH); discriminating (Braha).
by_area.finance: Spends on vile things and destroys wealth (Phaladeepika 8.33); unexpected expenses and debts (Braha); spends on charities (Chamatkar Chintamani); inherited property may be lost (Raman HJH).
by_area.health: Eye diseases (Phaladeepika 8.33; Chamatkar Chintamani); left eye or ear (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Befriended by lower classes (Raman HJH); little sexual pleasure (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Ketu does well in the 12th, giving spiritual insight (Frawley); excellent for a spiritual seeker (Braha). BPHS 33 places liberation with Ketu in the 12th from the Karakamsa (a different reference point).

strengtheners: Ketu unaspected by malefics in the 12th, or with a benefic in its own/exalted sign (Frawley, on strengthening Ketu)
Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: few unexpected expenses, fine spiritual tendencies, success abroad (Braha)
Benefic aspect (BPHS 33, for Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa, especially in Aries or Sagittarius)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Malefic aspect or conjunction blocks liberation in the Karakamsa rule (BPHS 33)
Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th associated with those houses' lords: harm in its dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 17-18)
lagna_or_context_notes: Rahu is in the 6th. The liberation reading in BPHS 33 is counted from the Karakamsa, not the lagna; Raman HJH also cites it (Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa gives final emancipation).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.33 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Commits sins secretly, spends money on vile things, destroys wealth, follows forbidden conduct, suffers eye disease.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 9 (Rahu and Ketu), sutras 31-32 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 12th: few children, eye troubles, an unhappy after-life.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 12th (Ketu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Like a king, spends on charities, vanquishes enemies, suffers eye troubles.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 33 (Karakamsa) (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1)
source_views.view: Ketu in the 12th from the Karakamsa, especially in Aries or Sagittarius with a benefic aspect, gives final emancipation; with malefic influence it does not.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the twelfth house ('Planets in the Twelfth House')
source_views.view: Restless, wandering mind; leaves the country of birth; befriended by the lower classes; inherited property may be lost. (Elsewhere in the 12th-house chapter: Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa gives final emancipation.)

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Capricious, unsettled mind, foreign residence, traveller; also lists licentiousness.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses', p. 145, and remedial-measures chapter (pp. ~258-259)
source_views.view: Ketu does well in the 12th, giving spiritual insight and protection from negative psychic influences; Ketu in the 12th unaspected by malefics is a strong Ketu.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Ketu in the 12th house' section
source_views.view: Excellent for the spiritual seeker: discrimination and interest in spiritual evolution; but unexpected expenses, debts, little sexual pleasure; scriptures add wasteful spending and left eye/ear trouble.

source_views.source: Andrew Foss, The Yoga of the Planets: Ketu, the South Node (commentary on the 108-name list of the graha), names 74
source_views.view: In the twelfth house or sign Ketu can cause heroism or enmity (74).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. Phaladeepika is wholly negative; Chamatkar Chintamani gives royal status and charity; Frawley and Braha make the 12th Ketu's best house for spirituality. The well-known 'Ketu in 12th gives moksha' rule in BPHS is counted from the Karakamsa, not the lagna.
phrasing_guidance: Lead with the inward, spiritual and charitable potential, and with life or work abroad; suggest mindful spending and rest. Do not promise liberation or discuss after-death states.
